what: Per-route check of the 27 routes whose Planner descent or car-to-car time ran more than 20% short of online trip-report times (>= 2 reports, none excluded), after #2266/#2275. Stored `timing` is 'published times for a fit party', so it was never overwritten in bulk with report medians; each row was read on its own, over up to three research passes.
rule: A published route figure (guidebook, route page or guide itinerary) for this route and trailhead wins; inside a published RANGE, the timed reports' median clamped into it.
With no published figure: the median of >= 3 independent timed reports, or 2 that agree. A report whose times the stored row was taken from (sameAsStored) checks nothing and is left out.
A leg counts as evidence when it starts and ends at the same two places, whatever the party's objective (pass 3): a shared descent route, a shared walk out.
Only a leg the Planner showed > 20% SHORT of that evidence was changed. A stored total is kept wherever the evidence allows; its parts are re-filed.

Multi-day rows keep the CAMP shape lib/planTimes.js reads (approach = car to camp, summit = the summit day from camp and back, descent = camp to car; approach and descent within 35%), because the alpine start counts back from that summit leg. A stored summit day stays unless the evidence puts it more than 20% off.
Every word written is our own; no source is named in the app. Compare-and-set with a rollback file (scripts/oneoff/apply-timing-fixes.mjs).
totalConvention: Measured over the 301 alpine/mountaineering/scrambling rows storing all four figures: 276 store totalHrs as the SUM of the legs (moving time); a handful store elapsed time with nights (Elephant Butte +24, Gunrunner +20). Ptarmigan's 30 is moving time with its 14.3 hr traverse unfiled (no summit).

routes.why: The convention is settled by measurement: 276 of 301 alpine rows that store all four figures store the total as the SUM of moving legs (only a handful store elapsed time), and Ptarmigan's 30 hr is 5.7 + a 14.3 hr traverse with no leg of its own + 10. As moving time, 30 hr sits within 20% of a guide itinerary's 36-54 hr fit-party end and matches four-day parties at about 8 hr a day; one 2016 report summed 44 hr over five travel days. Not short against the published figure, so left.
